database.reason: No server-side state. Only persistence is localStorage for personal best score — entirely client-side.

deploy.reason: Static SPA with zero backend requirements. GitHub Pages specified in original brief. Zero cost, zero config, permanent URL.

auth.reason: Single-player anonymous game. No user accounts, no protected resources.

framework.reason: Vanilla HTML + CSS + JS. No bundler, no transpiler. The absence of a framework is a portfolio signal — clean source code, sub-100KB total weight. A framework scaffold would add complexity with zero user-facing benefit for a single-page game.

font.reason: Single quality sans-serif from Google Fonts. CDN-cached, swap prevents FOIT. Specific typeface to be determined by DESIGN discipline.

factory_decisions.file_structure: Flat — index.html, style.css, game.js at root. No src/ directory, no module bundling.
factory_decisions.version_control: Git, gh-pages branch for deployment, main branch for source.
factory_decisions.ci_cd: None required — push to gh-pages branch triggers GitHub Pages rebuild automatically. No build step needed.
factory_decisions.env_vars: None — no secrets, no API keys, no configuration.
